title: Kindness That Never Leaves
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who turns a truth over slowly, and tonight's promise is one to hold quietly: she spilled juice and froze, her mom only handed her a towel and hummed, and Wren thought about it all afternoon, the way a child thinks about a kindness that did not leave.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because some truths are best held quietly and turned over slowly. In Wren's world today: Wren spilled juice across her mom's clean floor and froze, waiting. Mom only handed her a towel and hummed while they wiped it up together. Wren thought about it all afternoon. Just like the people who heard that Heavenly Father's kindness would never depart, Wren learned that real love stays when we make a mess.
